decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The hardstanding area contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as the ancillary storage area for plant equipment hire for the Class B8 of Unit 2.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The site shall be used for a hardstanding area for the storage of plant equipment hire and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Condition : 4 - 4.	No machinery shall be operated, no process shall be carried out and no deliveries taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am to 6pm Monday to Friday and 9am to 1pm Saturday, or at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - 5.	No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 6.	No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the position and design of a 1.8m high palisade fence to be erected on the southern boundary the side abutting Shield Road. The fence shall match the existing adjoining fence along the southern boundary of Unit 2 and shall be completed before the hardstanding area is used. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - 7.	No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating a soft landscaping strip 1.5 metres deep along the southern boundary of the site and indicating the proposed species. The landscaping shall be completed before the hardstanding area is used. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - 8.	No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan detailing the surface materials of the hardstanding area. The hardstanding area shall be constructed and completed in accordance with the surface materials approved by the local planning authority prior to the site being used for the storage of plant equipment. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - 9.	The construction of the site drainage system shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Planning Authority before the development commences.

Condition : 10 - Informatives

1.	The applicant is advised that under the terms of the Water Resources Act 1991, the prior written consent of the Environment Agency is required for any discharge of sewage or trade effluent into controlled waters (e.g. watercourses and underground waters).

2.	The applicant is advised that prior written consent of the Environment Agency is required for dewatering from any excavation or development into a surface watercourse.
description: Demolition of existing warehouse and creation of hardstanding area for storage of plant equipment hire.
